source.notes: A mutating POST /sap/bc/adt/programs/programs sent with x-csrf-token: fetch (the literal string 'fetch', asking the server to hand back a fresh token) instead of a real token is rejected outright: 403 Forbidden, plain-text body 'CSRF token validation failed', response header x-csrf-token: Required. The server does NOT treat a mutating request carrying 'fetch' as an implicit token-fetch-then-retry; the write is refused. Paired with the csrf-required-403-followup-verify cassette (072), which confirms the rejected create had no side effect. Authorization/set-cookie header values were already redacted at the source (placeholders preserved as-is).
